subject: Re: Offline deployment gating, artifact entitlement, and emergency rollback
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@blueharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: atlas-ops@blueharbor.com
Date: 2025-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offline delivery gating and rollback — BlueHarbor scope

Naomi,

Thanks again for the call this morning. BlueHarbor will be moving one of our regional clusters to a sealed, offline environment in Q4 and we need a concrete checklist for: artifact entitlement (who can sign), on-site operator acceptance, and an emergency rollback path in case a signed image fails validation post-activation.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood provide a sample signed-manifest format and the exact fields you require for entitlement checks?
- What does the operator ceremony look like (roles, signers, minutes)?
- We need a guaranteed rollback window of at least 2 hours from activation where the operator can revert to the previous bundle with minimal downtime — what do you recommend?

We also have a SOC2 on-site coming up; any linkage between the update process and audit evidence would be helpful.

Samir
Director, Infrastructure Operations
BlueHarbor Systems

Attachments: none

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery gating and rollback — BlueHarbor scope

Samir —

Appreciate the clear asks. I attached an initial proposal (redwood-offline-ops-proposal-v1.pdf) and a sample signed-manifest (signed-manifest-v1.txt). High level summary below; full detail is in the PDF.

1) Signed manifest / entitlement fields (required):
   - bundle_id (UUID), bundle_version, model_commit, build_signature (SHA256), signer_id (key id), signer_role (operator|auditor|redwood), timestamp_utc, allowed_activation_window (start/end), emergency_rollback_token (opaque id).

2) Operator ceremony:
   - Minimum quorum: 2 onsite operators + 1 remote auditor (HSM-backed signatures).
   - Procedure: manifest verification -> offline preflight (integrity + smoke tests) -> timed activation window -> post-activation smoke run (10 min).
   - Template minutes: see operator-ceremony-template.docx attached.

3) Rollback plan:
   - Activation is orchestrated by a signed activation message that references the previous bundle id. If health-checks fail within the agreed rollback window (we propose 2 hours), automated orchestrator will trigger revert to the previous image and publish an audit event.
   - Requirements on your side: network path between operator workstation and the orchestration jump host (over a one-way bastion if preferred), and access to the cached previous bundle in the sealed depot.

4) Evidence for SOC2:
   - We emit an immutable activation ledger (signed events) plus operator minutes. All artifacts and signatures are exportable as JSON lines for audit ingestion.

Next steps: if you can confirm the quorum and the desired activation window we’ll finalize the manifest schema and produce a pre-signed bundle for your acceptance test.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-offline-ops-proposal-v1.pdf, signed-manifest-v1.txt, operator-ceremony-template.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-22T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery gating and rollback — BlueHarbor scope

On Thu, Aug 21, 2025 at 12:03 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Signed manifest / entitlement fields (required):
>    - bundle_id (UUID), bundle_version, model_commit, build_signature (SHA256), signer_id (key id), signer_role (operator|auditor|redwood), timestamp_utc, allowed_activation_window (start/end), emergency_rollback_token (opaque id).

This is good — a couple practical notes from ops:
- build_signature: we should include both artifact SHA256 and a separate layer-level Merkle root so you can validate deltas quickly on-site.
- signer_role: add "courier" for transport-stamped endorsements if you plan to accept physical media from an external shipper.
- allowed_activation_window: please support RFC3339 times with timezone; some of BlueHarbor's sites run on local time for operator convenience.

Jonas — can you confirm HSM key policies? Specifically we need to define whether BlueHarbor will provide an HSM for local signing or Redwood will pre-sign with our HSM and provide a short-lived delegation key.

Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-22T10:18:00-07:00

Naomi/Marissa/Samir — quick notes:
- Preferred pattern: customer provides an HSM-backed root and we do a delegated signing flow (Redwood issues subordinate key that is sealed to the site). This keeps root ownership with the customer.
- For emergency rollback tokens: encrypt the token with the site's public key and include a TTL. Redeeming the token triggers a signed revert transaction in the orchestrator.
- Acceptance smoke tests: include a small inference sanity check (fixed prompt -> expected token sequence hash). If that fails, orchestrator rolls back automatically.

I'll draft the HSM policy language and add a short sequence diagram to the proposal PDF.

- Jonas

Attachments: none

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@blueharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-23T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery gating and rollback — BlueHarbor scope

Thanks Naomi/Marissa/Jonas — this looks actionable and addresses the audit asks. A couple quick points before we lock in the SOW:
- Quorum: we can meet 2 onsite operators + 1 remote auditor.
- HSM: BlueHarbor will supply the root HSM; we prefer Redwood to provide a sealed subordinate key that we can rotate on a quarterly cadence.
- Please add a short section that describes the manual fallback (operator-driven revert) in case the automated rollback fails — that must include the exact CLI commands and the minimum network requirements.

If you can add those items I can present this to procurement next week and aim to get the PO approved within the month. Also please send the SOC2 evidence export example so our audit team can validate ingestion.

Samir
